knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The sharps container is checked and changed as required before the cleaner leaves the room, so it is never over the fill point at the next use.
Bagging at the point of use stops microorganisms from spreading into the surroundings or onto staff clothing.
The room is cleaned from least soiled to most soiled and top to bottom, so the linen comes out first and the floors and bathroom are left until later.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes a walkthrough of a mock room and marks each step in the procedure order; pass when all nine steps are in order
Learner checks the sharps container against the fill mark and states the action, with the correct action recorded
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed walkthrough checklist with assessor initials
stopWorkCriteria: Sharps container is at or over the fill point and cannot be changed
Used linen is found on the floor and cannot be bagged safely
Cleaner has an open wound on the hands that cannot be covered
